title: Herbal Bhuna Canadian Rhubarb Crumble
description: A cozy, herb-infused crumble featuring tart rhubarb and a fragrant bhuna spice blend, all sweetened naturally for a sugar-free-friendly treat.
instructions: In a bowl, mix rhubarb, lemongrass, ginger, garlic, cumin, coriander, turmeric, chili powder, salt, stevia, and olive oil until the fruit is well coated.
Transfer the mixture to a greased baking dish and spread evenly.
Bake for 20 minutes until the rhubarb is softened and caramelized.
While the rhubarb bakes, combine almond flour, oats, remaining stevia, and a pinch of salt to form the crumble topping.
Once the rhubarb is done, sprinkle the crumble topping over the fruit.
Return the dish to the oven for an additional 15 minutes until the crumble is golden brown.
Allow the crumble to rest for 5 minutes before serving warm.
Serve as is or topped with a dollop of dairy‑free yogurt for extra comfort.
